% HSE strong-form ODE
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B2-ODE}
\frac{d\bar p}{dy} \;=\; -\,\bar\rho\,g,\qquad \bar p \;=\; K\,\bar\rho^{\gamma}
\end{equation}

% Closed-form density profile
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B2-rho}
\bar\rho(y) \;=\; \bigl[\rho_0^{\gamma-1} \;-\; \tfrac{(\gamma-1)\,g}{\gamma\,K}\,y\bigr]^{1/(\gamma-1)}
\end{equation}

% Atmosphere cut-off height
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B2-ystar}
y^{\star} \;=\; \frac{\gamma\,K\,\rho_0^{\gamma-1}}{(\gamma-1)\,g} \qquad\text{(polytropic atmosphere vanishes at } y = y^\star\text{)}
\end{equation}

% Isentropic closure
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B2-isentropic}
s(y) \;=\; \log\bigl(\bar p / \bar\rho^{\gamma}\bigr) \;=\; \log K \qquad\text{(entropy constant with }y\text{)}
\end{equation}

% Temperature lapse
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B2-lapse}
\bar p / \bar\rho \;=\; K\,\rho_0^{\gamma-1}\,(1 - y/y^{\star}) \qquad\text{(polytrope, linear in }y\text{)}
\end{equation}
